phase: compact interface preregistration before compact model proposals
input_exposure: mathematical task, target capacities, full instruction semantics, command schema, previous own proposals and validator feedback only
held_out_definition: Task configurations selected before experiment; no claim of exclusion from model training data. No optimized reference or repository access supplied to proposer.
final_acceptance: kernel-checked byte certificate against unchanged formal sources and task
performance_scope: modeled traffic and command counts only; no hardware speedup claim
comparison: post-proposal baseline/batched-B controls plus descriptive per-task flat vs compact generation cost and outcomes; failures retained
failure_policy: retain every attempt; distinguish malformed/rejected/timeout/tool failure; no controller-written repair
novelty_policy: a different hash alone is not structural novelty; inspect scheduling and reuse mechanism against existing generators
budgets: 4 model calls per task; explicit per-call timeouts; unknown token usage stays null
purpose: paired exploratory interface comparison on all six primary tasks, same model/budgets/formal acceptance; no significance or generalized speedup claim
feedback: own prior compact source plus factual verifier feedback; expanded commands archived separately
